scope: Six actual outer nuts; six discrete clockings each. Whole tool against complete selected station/storage/remaining stock and nearby lab geometry. No approach or rotation sweep.
limitations: Exact contact clearance and fastener dimensions are inferred, not manufacturing tolerances. The selected 6.7 mm minimum axial overlap is a geometry screening threshold, not a rated engagement requirement.
Inner jam nuts, paired counterholding, insertion/removal, hand clearance, torque and load remain unqualified.
